text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Okay, our next training session is at 3 p.m.
See you in six and a half
hours.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After an early morning training session, I
walk with Eishin Flash to
class.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Did you hear? Best Crepe is gonna be at
the gates after school!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: For real? That's super rare! We have to go!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Best Crepe...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's a food truck for crepes—they don't
have an actual store. Their
crepes have
been all the talk amongst the students for
about half a
year now.

"Take a bite, hear destiny calling."
They
say words can't truly capture the taste.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The owner does things on a whim, meaning
the shop can pop up at
any time without
warning. It's known as the "phantom crepe
shop."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If those two are correct, it's coming here
after school.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well, mention of this crepe truck certainly
got her in a talkative
mood.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Not possible. We have training from 3 to 8
p.m., and there's no
record of it ever
staying that late.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...No, we don't need to change anything.
We've set our schedule, so
we should stick
to it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That's the proper way of doing things. Now
then, I have class in
fourteen minutes, so I
should get going.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's still adamant as ever about sticking
to her schedules, but she
doesn't seem all
too happy about missing out...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Once our after-school sessions are over,
we normally chat about her
progress, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I'll be heading out early today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She runs right off... Her eagerness reminds
me of our exchange this
morning.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My guess turns out to be right—I find her
in front of the school gates,
but there's no
one else around.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Going by hashtagged posts on social
media, it left somewhere
between an hour
and an hour and forty-six minutes ago.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Best Crepe has come to the school three
times now, and all three
times, it hasn't fit
into my schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This means more to her than I thought. But
given how unpredictable
the food truck is,
there's really only one thing she can do.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I know you're trying to be helpful, but I
can't do that.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I am curious about it, but I can't let a simple curiosity throw off my perfect schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Following it to the letter is what makes me
stronger. So no, I can't
adjust it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Next time, I'll try to find out when it'll be
here before I make my
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm going back to my dorm. See you
tomorrow at 6 a.m.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's one of her best strengths—sticking
to her beliefs no matter
what comes her
way. Even so... I feel she could learn to
treat herself
now and then.
